grouping_policy.grouping: current-round trajectories determine the current denominator; v28r1 groups are a separate conservative comparison
grouping_policy.start: observe immediately preceding first nonempty WM frame; otherwise first red detection
grouping_policy.end: before delivery_phase_start; delivery outcomes remain separately reported
grouping_policy.normalization: remove absolute ticks, map/package/track IDs, blue detections, pre-confirmation patrol; robot/WM positions relative to first retained observation
grouping_policy.comparison: same target-event order and categorical fields; complete-link groups (every member pair must match)
grouping_policy.success: all group members confirmed AND grabbed the WM-associated real target; mixed outcomes fail
grouping_policy.stationary_repeat: consecutive actual observe calls at the same tick, or pose displacement <5cm AND heading change <10deg; prefer exact logged odometry, fallback to driver truth samples
grouping_policy.blocked_motion_guard: observe_motion_violation is a failed attempted observation; it fails its run and the guard gate even though the actual observe was prevented
grouping_policy.fixed_rule_gates: no run may fail a fixed rule; every confirmed-and-grabbed run must pass every fixed rule; unreached-phase unknowns on unsuccessful runs remain unknown
grouping_policy.truth_association: WM-to-truth distance <=30cm; no raw-detection or nearest-only fallback labels
grouping_policy.two_ball_extension: selected-target fragments for both ball slots; explicit boundaries; same tolerances/complete-link; never only first ball
